description: Chart 12 — Melbourne transport network, up close. A zoomed companion to the statewide map (chart-11): the same train + tram routes and stop mesh, but framed on inner Melbourne (lon 144.75–145.35, lat −37.92 to −37.67) so the tram grid and the radial train lines become legible. Routes, base, and stops are all Melbourne-clipped (the stops via an in-spec filter on the shared CSV, so this view adds no extra download for them) and the projection auto-fits to that extent — no manual scale/translate. Route lines are thickened here because the lines are the subject. Same honesty footing as chart-11: lines show where routes run and dots where you board, never service times.

layer.description: Base: inner-Melbourne SA2 boundaries (clipped + simplified) for orientation — the Port Phillip Bay edge reads as the coastline.
Public-transport stops within the Melbourne frame, as a faint neutral mesh. Filtered in-spec from the shared statewide stops CSV.
Train and tram routes, thickened — the subject of this close-up. Train (metro + regional) vs Tram in the same neutral slate as chart-11 so the two maps share a legend meaning.
